question: By what percent did Energy revenue grow from 2024 to 2025?
sql:
-- Assumption: "Energy revenue" means all regions combined, and growth compares full-year 2025 with full-year 2024 (calendar years, all months in the data).
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT substr(s.month, 1, 4) AS yr, SUM(s.revenue_gbp) AS revenue
  FROM sales s
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'Energy'
    AND substr(s.month, 1, 4) IN ('2024', '2025')
  GROUP BY substr(s.month, 1, 4)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2025' THEN revenue END)
               - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2024' THEN revenue END))
        / SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2024' THEN revenue END), 2) AS growth_pct
FROM yearly;
assumption: "Energy revenue" means all regions combined, and growth compares full-year 2025 with full-year 2024 (calendar years, all months in the data).

question: How did Carbonated volume in the South in July 2024 compare with July 2023, in percent?
sql:
-- Assumption: "July 2024" and "July 2023" are the months 2024-07 and 2023-07 as stored in the month column, and the comparison is (2024 volume - 2023 volume) / 2023 volume x 100.
WITH v AS (
  SELECT s.month, SUM(s.volume_cases) AS volume_cases
  FROM sales s
  JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = s.region_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id
  WHERE r.region_name = 'South'
    AND p.category = 'Carbonated'
    AND s.month IN ('2023-07', '2024-07')
  GROUP BY s.month
)
SELECT
  (SELECT volume_cases FROM v WHERE month = '2023-07') AS volume_2023_07,
  (SELECT volume_cases FROM v WHERE month = '2024-07') AS volume_2024_07,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * ((SELECT volume_cases FROM v WHERE month = '2024-07') - (SELECT volume_cases FROM v WHERE month = '2023-07'))
    / (SELECT volume_cases FROM v WHERE month = '2023-07'),
    2
  ) AS pct_change;
assumption: "July 2024" and "July 2023" are the months 2024-07 and 2023-07 as stored in the month column, and the comparison is (2024 volume - 2023 volume) / 2023 volume x 100.

question: How did revenue in the latest quarter compare with the same quarter a year earlier, in percent?
sql:
-- Assumption: the data ends in 2025-12, so the latest quarter is Q4 2025 (2025-10 to 2025-12) and the same quarter a year earlier is Q4 2024 (2024-10 to 2024-12).
WITH q AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN month BETWEEN '2025-10' AND '2025-12' THEN 'latest'
              WHEN month BETWEEN '2024-10' AND '2024-12' THEN 'prior'
         END AS period,
         SUM(revenue_gbp) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE month BETWEEN '2024-10' AND '2024-12'
     OR month BETWEEN '2025-10' AND '2025-12'
  GROUP BY period
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'latest' THEN revenue END), 2) AS revenue_q4_2025_gbp,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'prior' THEN revenue END), 2) AS revenue_q4_2024_gbp,
       ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'latest' THEN revenue END)
              - MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'prior' THEN revenue END)) * 100.0
              / MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'prior' THEN revenue END), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM q;
assumption: the data ends in 2025-12, so the latest quarter is Q4 2025 (2025-10 to 2025-12) and the same quarter a year earlier is Q4 2024 (2024-10 to 2024-12).
